did: r1131: the open-fill gate went blind whenever the intraday marks lane missed a session (3 permanent holes: 10-22, 10-23, 10-26), so the fill-price check reported NO_EVIDENCE for days that could in fact be checked. A same-day fill whose bar is missing is status=no_bar, never zero_pending (that would read as a clean pass over absent evidence). Measured live on 2026-10-26: COMPOSITE-CE-02 513100 cost 2.233 vs bar open 2.2330, rel 0.0, so the engine really did fill at the official open. Verdicts now also persist to results/t35_evidence_history.jsonl one line per (day, tier) because a fallback verdict is unrepeatable -- it can only be computed while the states still call the fill same-day. Surfaced on the CEO dashboard as an 'open-fill verification' row (tier + day + rows checked) and carried in the paper block, so a weaker-source day reads as 'checked by the bar' rather than 'unverified'.
